text:
nora.p: Heads up 10m ago - FinSuite's procurement flow uploads an AdobeSign ZIP and the marketplace is rejecting it with a checksum mismatch. Customer won't accept any other upload format. :exclamation:
sam.k: on the call, they said this is blocking provisioning; need a path forward within 48h or they pause activation.
julian.eng: logs show `attachment_checksum_mismatch`. We changed the archive normalizer recently which can alter envelope bytes.
ada.ops: Ops sees risk if we preserve raw bytes (storage, zip-bomb). We'll need per-tenant quotas and a scanner if we do this.
anil.legal: We cannot accept modified signed artifacts without explicit customer consent. Propose a scoped opt-in: per-tenant "preserve-original-blob" route plus a signed waiver and audit entry.
julian.eng: Tech estimate: 1 engineer ~ 2 days to add a header flag that bypasses normalization and streams the original blob, plus 0.5d for zip-scan. Ops ~3h to wire a feature-flagged canary for the tenant.
marketplace-bot: created ticket MP-7007 "preserve-original-zip-tenant-canary" assigned to @julian.eng.
nora.p: sales will request signed waiver now. Can legal draft short consent text?
anil.legal: drafting: "By opting into original-blob ingestion Customer acknowledges Redwood will persist uploaded artifacts without normalization for PO acceptance; Customer is responsible for signature verification and indemnifies Redwood for signature disputes." I'll DM exact wording.
sam.k: If customer signs, please enable canary and monitor ingestion events. Sales/ops will coordinate scope.
julian.eng: once waiver lands we can open PR and flip canary within 24-36h.
nora.p: thanks everyone. I'll paste the signed ACK here when received. :thumbsup:
